transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been getting really slowed down at work. Like, my hands feel like they’re moving through glue. Even simple stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now, and people have started noticing I’m just not as quick as I used to be.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… most days I wake up feeling really down. It’s like this heavy, flat sadness in my chest, and I just think, what’s the point of even trying to build the life I was planning?
Do you find that even things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, don’t bring you any pleasure anymore?

Yeah. I used to like talking with my clients and being kind of upbeat at work, and I’d help the newer stylists when they needed it. I also used to go hiking with my friends. Now I mostly just keep my head down and avoid people. It’s not that I hate them or anything, I just… don’t have that spark in me anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way — the sadness, slowed-down feeling, and losing interest in things?
It’s been going on for about a year and two months now. The heavy depression and feeling slowed down… it’s pretty much been there that whole time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past year?
Yeah, my appetite’s been off. I’ll skip meals without really meaning to, and then at night I realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a few bites of something. My clothes have gotten looser too.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah. I keep thinking I’m just a burden on everyone. Like I should be able to handle basic things, but I couldn’t keep my money straight, or my job, or even the normal responsibilities at the salon. It makes me feel like I deserve what’s happening.
Have you ever felt this way before, with a period of sadness or loss of interest that lasted for a couple of weeks or more?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve felt down before, but this is different. Most days I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. It feels like there’s no point in trying to build the life I thought I was going to have.
Have you ever had a previous episode of depression that lasted for several weeks or more, where you felt the same kind of sadness and loss of interest you're experiencing now?
Yeah… it’s the same kind of feeling now. Most days I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. It feels like there’s no real point in trying to build the life I was planning.
Between this current period of sadness and any earlier times you felt down, were there any periods where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of months before feeling this way again?

I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having a clear couple months where I felt totally better. There were times I could get through things a little more, but I don’t know if I’d call it significantly better.
Before this current time, did you ever have a period of at least two months where you felt clearly better and back to your usual self?
I don’t know if I can say that. I don’t remember a solid two months where I felt clearly back to myself. Maybe there were better stretches, but not like fully okay.
